maria (Finance): Heads up — we're seeing a ~$642.30 discrepancy between the AWS Marketplace statement and the ResellerX payout for Dec reserved commits. Anyone seen this before?
ajay (CloudOps): @maria which reseller and which marketplace file? aws or gcp?
maria (Finance): AWS via ResellerX (reseller-id: RSLR-42). Statement shows credit for Committed Usage SKU 12345 = $12,450.00. Reseller payout csv shows $11,807.70. subtotal diff = $642.30.
ken (Billing): Can you paste the exact statement lines + the payout rows? quick look might show fees or tax.
maria (Finance): Sure — extracted lines below:
```
-- AWS Marketplace statement (aws-stmt-2025-12.csv) --
line 14, SKU 12345, Committed Usage, us-west-2, $12,450.00
-- ResellerX payout (resellerx-payout-2025-12.csv) --
row 137, SKU 12345, vendor_amount, USD, $11,807.70
```
ken (Billing): Quick calc: 12,450 - 11,807.70 = 642.30. Not a round percent fee. Could be FX/rounding or a manual adjustment.
sarah (Revenue Ops): Check tax columns in the payout CSV — sometimes partners net taxes or withholding there.
maria (Finance): Tax column is 0. Currency is USD in both files. Region labeling is odd: statement tags us-west-2 but payout aggregates to "us-west".
ajay (CloudOps): Region mismatch can change pricing tiers for some reseller mappings. Also check whether this was auto-applied to a different invoice (refunds sometimes get reallocated). Any commits cancelled in Dec?
billing-bot: New document uploaded: aws-reseller-statement-2025-12.json (metadata saved).
ken (Billing): I'll run a line-by-line reconcile. running locally: 
```bash
python scripts/reconcile_marketplace.py --statement aws-stmt-2025-12.csv --payout resellerx-payout-2025-12.csv --out mismatch-2025-12.csv
```
maria (Finance): Please paste the mismatch CSV when done, and open a ticket with ResellerX for a line-level ledger. Creating internal ticket #BILL-412 and assigning to @ken.
ken (Billing): Reconcile result snippet:
```
SKU,statement_amt,payout_amt,diff
12345,12450.00,11807.70,642.30
--TOTAL DIFF--, , ,642.30
```
ken (Billing): I dug into our commit records — there was a commit refund on 2025-12-18 for CID-98765 (refund $2,000). If reseller applied prorate/refund differently, it could produce small deltas.
ajay (CloudOps): Confirmed refund record on CID-98765. Sometimes partner portals apply refunds against last invoice period and then net out FX/rounding. Could be rounding + FX.
sarah (Revenue Ops): Also confirm reseller payout cycle — ResellerX had a currency-conversion adjustment note on 2025-12-31 in their monthly memo. Might explain fractional shortfall.
maria (Finance): Action items: 
- @ken escalate to ResellerX asking for a line-level ledger and FX/rounding notes (filed ticket RSLR-42/TKT-988)
- @ajay correlate CID-98765 allocation in their portal vs our ledger
- @sarah validate whether the rounding/FX is our liability per contract
I'll hold GL adjustments until reseller response.
ken (Billing): Filed: RSLR-42/TKT-988 — request sent for breakdown, FX rates used, and any manual adjustments in Dec. pinged partner ops. :thumbsup:
billing-bot: Ticket RSLR-42/TKT-988 created and assigned to ResellerX support.
(30m later)
maria (Finance): Update from ResellerX ledger snippet they just sent: "partner_fee 5% = -622.50, platform_fee 1.2% = -149.40, rounding & FX adj = +129.60" — their numbers don't match our extract.
ken (Billing): If they claim fees that sum differently we need full ledger, not summary. Asking for the CSV lines and the FX table.
sarah (Revenue Ops): I'll validate contract: our reseller agreement caps platform fee at 3% for commitments. If they're charging 6.2% we escalate.
maria (Finance): Also seeing an explicit line "rounding_adjustment -642.30" in their ledger note — need source. Could be they neted a late credit from a different account.
ajay (CloudOps): I'm going to query our commit-to-account mapping for CID-98765 and check whether the refund was routed to the reseller or to a direct customer invoice.
(1h)
ken (Billing): Reseller provided per-line CSV. I reconciled: they moved an internal credit from a customer to our reseller pool and applied FX rounding that produced -642.30 to our payout. I've attached (pasted) the two rows they used.
maria (Finance): Thanks. @sarah please confirm whether contract allows passthrough of partner FX/rounding. If not, we request reversal.
sarah (Revenue Ops): Contract shows we absorb up to $100 per month rounding per partner; anything larger must be pre-approved. I'll draft escalation.
maria (Finance): Final for now: flag as "investigating — partner adjustment". Ken to await reseller reversal or explanation by EOD PST; Ajay to confirm CID allocation. If unresolved by EOD we escalate to Partnerships and Legal.
ken (Billing): No objections. moving ticket RSLR-42/TKT-988 to high priority.
billing-bot: Ticket status changed: RSLR-42/TKT-988 -> awaiting partner reply.
maria (Finance): I'll update GL only after we get partner confirmation. will post final once closed. calendar:reminder for follow-up tomorrow 09:30 PST. :calendar:
